Fuel and Onion Prices Surge, Affecting Consumers and Politics

Fuel and transport costs have led to a surge in onion prices, impacting consumers. In the United States, rising fuel prices ahead of the 2026 midterm elections are putting pressure on Republican candidates as voters grapple with increased costs. Iran has criticized the US over blame for the fuel price surge amid conflict, with an Iranian official calling the accusation "Hitler-like." Politicians are aware that rising gas prices can negatively affect their electoral prospects.
